facts.text: I am planning a trip to Cedar Point.
I got back from a Saturday at Universal Studios Hollywood with my friends Emma and Ryan.
I am thinking of going to Cedar Point in the spring.
I rode awesome roller coasters at Universal Studios Hollywood last Saturday with Emma and Ryan.
I rode the mazes for The Exorcist, The Texas Chainsaw Massacre, and Halloween.
My favorite maze was The Exorcist.
I am excited to experience real roller coasters at Cedar Point.
I think I should prioritize Steel Vengeance or Millennium Force first.
I will start with Steel Vengeance.
I am intrigued by Steel Vengeance's hybrid design and airtime hills.
I think Steel Vengeance's wooded setting sounds really cool.
I am curious about the queue and the theming around Steel Vengeance.
I am stoked to ride Steel Vengeance.
I love the idea of being immersed in an abandoned mining town on Steel Vengeance.
I am curious about the preshow for Steel Vengeance.
I have heard about a new coaster being built at Knott's Berry Farm.
I have been to Knott's Scary Farm recently.
I went to Knott's Scary Farm with my sister and her boyfriend.
At Knott's Scary Farm, we did the trick-or-treat trail.
At Knott's Scary Farm, we rode the Calico Mine Ride.
The Calico Mine Ride was decorated for Halloween.
We did not do as many mazes as we wanted because of long lines.
I am looking forward to going back to Knott's Berry Farm.
I am looking forward to checking out the new coaster at Knott's Berry Farm when it opens.
